description: PPW Ferry is a dataset listed in Pierce County open data portal (internal.open.piercecountywa.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a region, state, county or agency, published or maintained by Pierce County. Pierce County ferry system ridership data. Coverage: Pierce County, Washington. The portal files it under the category Transportation. Its tags are pierce county ferry, steilacoom, ferry, ketron island, anderson island. The table has 6 columns. The portal shows 2022-05-05 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support port and shipping studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-internal-open-piercecountywa-gov-portal.
